mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ( `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY , `essay` LONGTEXT CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL , `name` VARCHAR( 2000 ) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL, `author` VARCHAR( 2000 ) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL, `brief` VARCHAR( 2000 ) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL, `image` VARCHAR( 2000 ) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL, `deleted` INT( 3 ) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `createtime` DATETIME NOT NULL , `updatetime` TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , INDEX ( `deleted` , `updatetime` ) ) ENGINE = INNODB CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci;
